events.verdict: Valanciunas (TOR) is in the paint for less than three seconds when he is imminently exiting.
Gobert (UTA) sets the screen on DeRozan (TOR) and gives him room to avoid the contact. Both players briefly engage and separate after the screen.
LO SLA shows Ingles (UTA) makes contact with Valanciunas' (TOR) arm before making contact with the ball.
RATR shows Lowry (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Mitchell (UTA) during his drive.
Wright (TOR) and Mitchell (UTA) briefly engage and separate during the screen.
Rubio (UTA) legally contests Lowry's (TOR) jump shot attempt. Any "high-five" contact after the release of the shot is considered incidental.
Gobert (UTA) briefly grasps Valanciunas' (TOR) jersey, but does not affect his ability to retrieve the rebound.
RATR shows Lowry (TOR) makes clean contact with the ball during Mitchell's (UTA) driving shot attempt.
Rubio (UTA) is late to the spot and makes body-to-body contact with DeRozan (TOR) that affects his SQBR.
DeRozan (TOR) cleanly dislodges the ball from Rubio (UTA) during the rebound.
Ingles (UTA) briefly engages with DeRozan (TOR), but does not affect his FOM.
Ingles (UTA) legally contests DeRozan's (TOR) jump shot attempt.
Lowry (TOR) commits a take foul on O'Neale (UTA).
